card.name: Linking words in patient-condition lists
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as "or" after an adjective like chronic or acute, and "are" after "women who", inside warnings about which patients a drug applies to.

modes.label: or after condition adjective
modes.description: The word "or" joins two condition descriptors, such as chronic or recurrent, or acute or severe.
modes.example: patients with chronic<< or>> recurrent infection.

modes.label: are after women who
modes.description: The word "are" follows "women who" in pregnancy or contraindication statements.
